items.title: Three equivalent descriptions of bounded injective amplitude
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises a complex of bounded injective amplitude in three ways, the third testing only against quotients of the ring by ideals, and the proof is a 45-line argument that walks around the equivalence. From a bounded complex of injectives it computes the Ext groups by the Hom complex into the injectives, which gives the vanishing for all modules; the implication to the bounded-test version is immediate; and the converse is the substantial part, where vanishing against quotients is used to show first that the cohomology is concentrated in the interval, then that the complex admits a right resolution by injectives vanishing below the interval, and finally that the truncation at the upper end can be replaced by an injective through a distinguished triangle. The construction of the resolution and the triangle step are the content, and both are displayed.
